changelog:
Version 7.8.64

Improvements

  • Faster first visit after you apply settings. APO now finds the main hero image even on pages with a long header or mega menu, and preloads the right image for phones and desktops from the very first page view, instead of waiting to learn it from visitors.
  • When the page is not learned yet, hero and header background images are no longer deferred, so the top of the page paints at once.
  • An image your theme already marks as high priority is respected when APO picks the hero; payment, card and badge images are never treated as the hero.
  • Once APO has measured a page, the cached copy is always refreshed with what it learned, also when several measurements arrive close together.
  • Switching from another cache plugin: if that plugin left its cache file behind after you deactivated it, APO now tells you and offers to install its own faster cache file with one click (the old file is kept as a backup). Files of active cache plugins are never touched.

Maintenance

  • Code comments tidied.
